contentHtml:
Sick of losing your passwords and resetting them all the time? There are good password managers and there are bad ones. I install and set up a genuinely reputable one on your computer and devices, so you have a single password for everything, and I set up two-factor login properly on the accounts that matter most. I help people across Stretton and Brisbane, onsite or remotely.

Reusing passwords puts every account at risk

The moment one website you use gets breached, every other account sharing that password is exposed too. Sticky notes, a notebook by the desk, or letting the browser remember everything are not secure, and they do not travel with you between devices.

Set up once, sorted for good

I work out which accounts matter most, set up a reputable password manager, move your existing logins into it, generate strong unique passwords where you need them, and turn on two-factor authentication on the accounts worth protecting properly, your email, banking and socials.

What is included

  • Cross-device setup, the same secure logins on your computer, phone and tablet.
  • Login migration, your existing passwords brought in and tidied up.
  • 2FA configuration on the accounts that matter, done properly so you are not locked out.
  • One-on-one training, so you are comfortable using it after I leave.

For broader protection see my computer and network security service, and if you suspect something has already got in, virus and spyware removal.

Send me the details for a quote or call 0477 319 160, with no call-out fee anywhere on Stretton.
